summary: The change implements indent/Format in hir/abap/format.go with a line/statement lexer that correctly tracks literals, string templates (with embedded expressions and escapes), both comment kinds, colon chains, keyword-named variables, and SELECT/ENDSELECT pairing; all acceptance bullets are covered by tests, verified against the full generated fixture corpus and the tsfront drivers, and cross-checked against real @abaplint/core's Indentation rule, which reports zero issues on all formatted output. 550k+ fuzz iterations (block nesting, reports/events/forms, comments, long-line wrapping) found no idempotency, token-preservation or 255-byte violations except one degenerate case below. The whole test suite passes and the golden file update is mechanical.

findings.claim: When wrapping splits a line at a between-statement cut, `best.next < len(stmts)` is taken to mean a statement starts later on this line, but cut.next is len(stmts) at scan time, i.e. the index of the next statement anywhere in the file (often on a later line). If the remainder of the line starts with something that never starts a statement - a stray second '.' (empty statement) after the closing period - the piece's indentation is taken from the unrelated later-line statement (e.g. ENDMETHOD, giving column 0 instead of 2), so a second Format pass moves the piece and Format is not idempotent. Trigger requires two consecutive periods on a >255-byte line, which this repo's emitters never generate; the empty-statement case is the only reachable form since trailing '"' comments are guarded.
findings.repro:
cat > /tmp/repro.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/oisee/abapiti/hir/abap"
)

func main() {
	src := "METHOD m.\nx |e f| 'v' =>s 'a b' p+q |j \\{ k| o= 'l''m' f( y ->r( ) `c d` 'v' : ) y , 'v' , |e f| ) |h \\| i| w y DATA 'l''m' && =1 : w ->r( ) x =>s , f( n w y DATA && |e f| n |{ x } g| |j \\{ k| ->r( ) |{ x } g| |h \\| i| |h \\| i| && . .\nENDMETHOD.\n"
	once, _ := abap.Format(src)
	twice, _ := abap.Format(once)
	fmt.Printf("idempotent: %v\nonce line 3: %q\ntwice line 3: %q\n", once == twice, once, twice)
}
EOF
cd /tmp && mkdir -p rp && mv repro.go rp/ && cd rp && cat > go.mod <<'EOF'
module rp

go 1.22

require github.com/oisee/abapiti v0.0.0

replace github.com/oisee/abapiti => /work
EOF
go mod tidy >/dev/null && go run . # prints idempotent: false; the wrapped stray '.' is at column 0 in run 1 and column 2 in run 2
